column1: {other} knows the name of every flower up there.
column2: 上面每种花的名字{other}都知道。

column1: Up the cliffs with {other} before breakfast.
{other} and I had our usual corner.
Talked boats with {other} till last orders.
{other} and I drank to absent friends.
column2: 我和{other}为不在的朋友干了一杯。

column1: {other} shuffles like a card sharp these days.
The pot went cold, we talked so long.
column2: 我们聊得太久，茶都凉了。

column1: {other} told me their news over tea.
column2: 喝茶时{other}跟我说了他们的新鲜事。

column1: {other} has a cup with their name on it at mine now.
column2: 现在我家有个写着{other}名字的杯子。

column1: Tea with {other}, same as every week.
{other} fixed my wobbly table while the kettle boiled.
column2: 水还没烧开，{other}就把我那张晃悠的桌子修好了。

column1: Danced with {other} till the fiddler gave up.
column2: 和{other}跳到拉琴的都拉不动了。

column1: {other} and I have a dance of our own now.
column2: 现在我和{other}有了自己的舞。

column1: Everyone stopped to watch {other} and me.
{other} swung me round so fast I saw stars.
{other} and I watched the tide turn, talking.
column2: 我和{other}边聊边看潮水转向。

column1: {other} told me about the old harbour.
{other} and I talked about the years gone by.
column2: 我和{other}聊起了过去的岁月。

column1: {other} says the water's warmer than it was.

column2: 我们把天下大事都理顺了。

column1: {other} needed a hand with a heavy crate at {place}.
{other} and I fixed the roof at {place} between us.
column2: 我和{other}两个人把{place}的屋顶修好了。

column1: They'll pay me back in pie.
{other} and I shifted half of {place} this afternoon.
column2: 今天下午我和{other}把{place}搬了一半。

column1: {other} can tie a bowline with their eyes shut now.
column2: 现在{other}闭着眼都能打单套结。

column1: Showed {other} a knot my grandad taught me.
column2: 教了{other}一个我爷爷教我的结。

column1: {other} tied a knot I'd never seen.
{other} is teaching the children knots now.
{other} and I made a rope ladder.
{other} and I have a plan for the spring.
{other} and I are planning a party for the whole harbour.
column2: 我和{other}在筹划一场全港口的聚会。
